historical_record.description: The R-3 lot had been used for years as a parking lot for customers, employees and delivery trucks of the Rose Exterminator Company. The City Planning Commission approved, with conditions on street trees, screening and lighting, the continued use of an R-3 lot for customer and employee parking for the Rose Exterminator Company.
